text: Yes, tree-cover loss has been increasing on this property in recent years. The largest losses occurred in 2021 (81.3 ha), followed by much smaller losses in 2022 (0.6 ha) and 2023 (4.5 ha). While 2022 saw minimal loss, the 2023 loss was significantly higher than 2022, indicating an upward trend. Historically, annual losses ranged between 0.7 and 1.8 ha, but the 2021 spike marks a sharp increase. The 2023 loss, though smaller than 2021, remains higher than pre-2020 averages, suggesting continued pressure on tree cover.
